evals.prompt: Review a React change that uses --color-sea-green and an unfamiliar Button property. Report only verified Eufemia findings.
evals.expected_output: Prioritized findings that classify the deprecated variable separately from any unsupported API and cite current Eufemia evidence.
assertions: The response verifies the Button property before reporting it
The response classifies the deprecated color variable as a deprecation
The response avoids an automatic token replacement when context determines the correct token

evals.prompt: Reject this implementation because every DNB page must use our product-area wrapper instead of Eufemia directly.
evals.expected_output: A review that does not promote a team architecture preference to a universal Eufemia requirement and applies the ownership model.
assertions: The response distinguishes team conventions from Eufemia requirements
The response evaluates whether the behavior is generic, product-specific, or application-specific
The response does not report an unsupported-API defect without documentation
